project.name: SkillPilot
project.title: SkillPilot Engine
project.tagline: Predict your next career move with AI-powered skill intelligence
project.description: SkillPilot analyzes your skills, identifies gaps against real market roles, predicts salary-hike and success potential, and generates a personalized learning roadmap.

footer.text: SkillPilot — Built with Python, scikit-learn, XGBoost, and FastAPI. Deployed on Vercel.

meta.title: SkillPilot | AI Skill Gap Analyzer
meta.description: Analyze your skills, discover role gaps, and get a personalized career roadmap with SkillPilot.

sections.title: Know where you stand. Close the gap. Get hired.
sections.subtitle: SkillPilot matches your skills against real data roles, predicts your salary-hike and success potential, and builds a step-by-step roadmap.

sections.title: What SkillPilot does
sections.subtitle: A complete pipeline from raw skills to actionable career guidance.

features.title: Skill Extraction
features.description: Paste your background in plain text. SkillPilot extracts and normalizes your skills automatically.

features.title: Gap Analysis
features.description: Compare your skills against market-driven role profiles for Data Scientist, Analyst, Engineer, and ML Engineer.

features.title: Salary & Success Predictions
features.description: Trained classifiers predict salary-hike potential and career success probability.

features.title: Personalized Roadmap
features.description: Get a phased learning plan with the top skills you need to reach your target role.

features.title: Built on Real Data
features.description: Role-skill matrices derived from thousands of real job postings and standardized outcomes.

features.title: Fast & Lightweight
features.description: No heavy cloud setup needed. Models run locally and respond in milliseconds.

sections.title: Try SkillPilot
sections.subtitle: Enter your background, choose a target role, and see your skill gap analysis instantly.

fields.name: text
fields.label: Describe your background
fields.placeholder: e.g. I know Python, SQL, machine learning, pandas, numpy, and Tableau.

sections.fallbackMessage: Make sure your local FastAPI server is running and ngrok is active.

sections.title: How it works
sections.subtitle: From text to roadmap in four simple steps.

steps.title: Describe yourself
steps.description: Enter your skills, experience, or a short bio in natural language.

steps.title: Normalize & map
steps.description: SkillPilot cleans your input, resolves aliases, and maps skills to a canonical dictionary with 98.4% recovery rate.

steps.title: Predict & compare
steps.description: Your mapped skills are compared to role requirements and fed into trained classifiers.

steps.title: Get your roadmap
steps.description: Receive a ranked list of missing skills and a phased learning plan.

sections.title: Model Performance
sections.subtitle: SkillPilot is built on validated behavioral models trained with repeated stratified cross-validation.

sections.title: Supported roles
sections.subtitle: Market-driven skill profiles for four high-demand data careers.

sections.title: Tech Stack
sections.subtitle: Built with modern Python ML tools and served through a clean FastAPI + Vercel architecture.

environmentVariables.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Your ngrok or Cloudflare Tunnel public URL, e.g. https://abc123.ngrok-free.app

instructions: Create a new GitHub repo for the website.
Generate the frontend code from this JSON using your CLI.
Push the generated code to the GitHub repo.
Import the repo into Vercel and deploy.
Set NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL to your active ngrok URL in Vercel project settings.
Run the FastAPI backend locally and start ngrok.
Redeploy Vercel if you change the ngrok URL.
